title: Pictures and videos are not in git

buildSteps.label: Why
buildSteps.description: Media are large and change often. Git holds the slides. A store holds the media: a cloud bucket, a Dropbox folder, or a folder on a shared disk.

buildSteps.label: In a deck
buildSteps.description: A deck's media sit in its public folder, which git ignores. A slide names a file, and npm run check says which files are missing.

buildSteps.label: Ask
buildSteps.description: "Use the folder ~/deck-media as the asset store, and push the media of the deck tutorial-agents." On another machine: "Pull the media of this deck."

buildSteps.label: What it will not do
buildSteps.description: Look for your access tokens, print them, or commit them. For a cloud bucket you create the token, and tell the agent where its configuration file is.
